title: Longest Increasing Path In a Matrix

examples.explanation: One best path is `1 -> 2 -> 6 -> 8`. The two `9`s do not extend it because moves must increase.

constraints: The grid has between 1 and 200 rows and between 1 and 200 columns.
Cell values are ordinary 32-bit signed integers, so they may be negative.
Moves are limited to the four orthogonal directions.
